name: 90274 · Pls Vrds Est, CA
findings: ZIP 90274 (Pls Vrds Est) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90274 (Pls Vrds Est) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
